Subject: Request: Stipend bridge + 30-day trial extension

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — Cinder Labs is excited about moving some inference workloads onto Redwood for our prototype. We ran into a cadence problem with our internal milestones and are short on remaining trial credits for the next sprint.

Would it be possible to get a one-time bridge top-up (additional $2k equivalent in credits) and a 30-day extension of our trial stipend? We have a planned demo with two pilot customers on July 26th and need the extra tokens to complete the integration and run latency profiles.

Quick context: current usage is ~120k tokens/week, mostly embeddings and short chat requests. Our security review is in progress; we can share the SOC-2 checklist responses today.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to provide a short mutual action plan or milestone checklist if that helps.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform
Cinder Labs

Hi Asha — quick follow up from our side.

Thanks for the usage snapshot. A couple clarifying points:
- You mentioned embeddings + short chat; can you confirm the specific model names (e.g., redwood-llama-13b-8bit or rw-instruct-large) and approximate seq lengths?
- Is the demo environment hitting our hosted API or will it run in your VPC/Dedicated test pool? Host vs Dedicated changes the approval path.

If you're on hosted API and staying within profiling/weblink demos, we typically can approve a one-off credit top-up + 30-day extension after a short MA( mutual action ) plan. If you need Dedicated reservation we'd have to route to Commercial (longer lead time).

Suggested next step: paste your simple milestone plan here (3 bullets: deliverable, date, success criteria) and I’ll draft the approval and terms.

— Mina
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
